1.e4 c6 2.Nc3 d5 3.d3 dxe4 4.Bg5.strategy: A gambit: White leaves e4 alone and develops the bishop outside the pawn chain with a pawn down. Nothing is under real threat, since Black's pieces easily guard e7, so Black keeps the extra pawn and the bishop is soon driven away.
1.e4 c6 2.Nc3 d5 3.d3 dxe4 4.Bg5.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Scorpion-Horus Gambit
